The '''Kashi Mer Dynasty''' was an isolationist [[Human/Legends|Human]] civilization from the planet [[Kashi]] in the [[Phelleem sector/Legends|Phelleem sector]].

==History==
The dynasty reached its height as the culture discovered ways in which to control and manipulate "the Breath," also known as [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="TOTJC">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''</ref>

[[Xendor]] was exiled from the Kashi Mer dynasty for using the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] in conjunction with the [[Teräs Käsi/Legends|Teräs Käsi]] martial art before he became a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].<ref name="cswe">{{CSWECite|III|341|Xendor}}</ref>

The culture was wiped out when the primary star supporting Kashi went [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]] in [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]], and the entire system was destroyed. Prior to this, the [[Kashi Mer talisman]] was stolen from the planet, and the supernova occurred shortly after the thief, [[Reda Jalooz]], returned to the planet seeking forgiveness.<ref name="Relic" /> The [[Orixon Nebula/Legends|Orixon Nebula's]] black halo is the remnant of the planet.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

The monarchy was guarded by the [[Royale Machetero]]s.<ref name="The Dark Forces Saga, Part 4">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050526a|series=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 4: Of the Crudest Matter}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]'', which is narrated in [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], describes the Kashi Mer Dynasty in the present tense in spite of the fact that [[Relic (article)|Relic]] had already established that the Kashi Mer Dynasty was wiped out "shortly after the formation of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]."
